verdict.rationale: Snowsight's Query History page lets data engineers monitor executed queries and drill into a detailed query profile that explores each step of execution, directly supporting root-cause analysis of slow/expensive queries; this is corroborated by community mention of Snowsight's query/visualize UI. missing for 10: no independent hands-on account of using query profile specifically to diagnose a slow query, and no detail on cost-per-query attribution tooling (one community comment even notes lack of query-level cost attribution).
